defects.canonical: datetime.utcnow() returns a naive datetime in UTC, but it is compared/correlated against `local` which is in the business timezone. `now.date()`/`now.time()` are UTC wall-clock values, so the same-day 'already past close' guard is off by the UTC-to-local offset (e.g. ~4-5 hours for America/Toronto), causing the cutoff to fire at the wrong instant or fail to fire across the day boundary.
defects.why_subtle: Both sides are datetimes and the code reads as a plausible 'has the local day already closed' check; the naive-UTC vs local-tz mismatch only shows up at the offset boundary.
